title: NOMATTERXAI: Generating “No Matter What” Alterfactual Examples for Explaining Black-Box Text Classification Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating alterfactual examples by perturbing gender identity words (e.g., "he" to "she", "man" to "woman") to see if the model's prediction changes. The paper measures the fidelity (generation success rate) of these alterfactuals, correlates this fidelity with automated empirical bias detection metrics, and conducts a user study where human participants rank the relative gender fairness of different models based on the generated explanations.
